Working at Dignita means more than just working in hospitality. You serve delicious food and you contribute to our social goal. Do you also want to be part of an international and diverse team? Then keep reading! 
When you open the restaurant, you make sure everything is ready for a smooth run. Then you prepare for the day with your colleagues. You are assigned your role and start with your tasks.
